neighbours.label: the subject noun of a conditional clause opened by 'if your' or 'unless your'
fire: The warranty still applies if your laptop stops working.
Shipping is free unless your order weighs over ten pounds.
Call the clinic right away if your child develops a rash.
You may need a permit if your house sits near a wetland.
Skip this step unless your printer needs new ink.
Rates rise quickly if your credit falls below a certain score.
The fee is waived if your account stays above the minimum.
No repair is needed unless your roof leaks during heavy rain.
quiet: The warranty was printed on the box your laptop came in.
Shipping took a week, and your order weighed over ten pounds.
The clinic called to say your child developed a rash.
You will love how your house sits near a wetland.
We finished this step and your printer got new ink.
Rates rose quickly, and your credit fell below a certain score.
The fee was waived because your account stayed above the minimum.
The repair was done after your roof leaked during heavy rain.

notes: Hedged ' can' and ' may' also fire the pole (0.63 in one probe), and this test does not cover them. Near misses keep 'your' plus the same noun outside a conditional.
